description: Audit an AI coding agent setup (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI or Cursor) and return a 0-100 score with concrete findings. Read-only: never modifies files.

agent.description: Which agent setup to check. Defaults to auto-detect.

minSeverity.description: Hide findings below this severity. The score itself is unaffected.

path.description: Project directory to audit. Defaults to the current directory.

scope.description: Which locations to check. Defaults to all.

name: doctor
title: Setup Doctor
